lessons.title: Powerhouse Parramatta opens this weekend – and it’s dazzling inside and out
lessons.title_zh: 耗資龐大的巴拉瑪塔動力博物館本週末開幕——內部與外部同樣令人驚豔

paragraphs.en: The new Powerhouse Parramatta in western Sydney is opening its doors on Saturday with five new exhibitions and a 23-day festival. Often called the Opera House of western Sydney, the venue features a white lattice exoskeleton made of 1,300 individual pieces, wrapping around 30,000 square metres of interior space. However, the project has also faced a controversial history since it was announced in 2014. A group of critics, led by former staff and trustees, has complained that the museum neglected its Ultimo site to fund this new infrastructure project. They also argued that the museum shifted away from its traditional focus toward contemporary art and events.
paragraphs.zh: 位於雪梨西部的全新巴拉瑪塔動力博物館（Powerhouse Parramatta）將於週六開幕，推出五個全新展覽及為期二十三天的節慶活動。這座場館常被稱為雪梨西部的歌劇院，其特色在於採用由一千三百個獨立組件組成的白色網格狀外骨骼結構，包覆著三萬平方公尺的室內空間。然而，自從該計畫於二〇一四年宣布以來，也面臨了充滿爭議的歷史。由前員工及董事會成員領導的一群批評者抱怨，該博物館忽略了烏爾蒂莫（Ultimo）館址，將資金轉而投入這個新的基礎設施計畫。他們也主張，該博物館已從傳統焦點轉向當代藝術與活動。

paragraphs.en: The massive price tag of 915 million dollars also drew heavy scrutiny during a period of financial precarity for the arts. This led to a New South Wales Treasury investigation regarding the museum's governance and procurement practices, and CEO Lisa Havilah was stood down ten weeks before the opening. To welcome the public, the museum is offering a 23-day festival with performances, parties, and workshops, where 65% of the program will be free. Visitors walking through the building will notice a calm atmosphere, featuring an airy colour palette and interior walls covered in a textured render made from 600,000 crushed oyster shells.
paragraphs.zh: 在藝術界財務不穩定的時期，高達九億一千五百萬美元的驚人價格也引發了嚴格審查。這導致新南威爾斯州財政部（New South Wales Treasury）針對該博物館的管理與採購實務展開調查，執行長麗莎·哈維拉（Lisa Havilah）則在開幕前十 weeks（應譯為十週）被暫停職務。為了迎接大眾，博物館推出了為期二十三天的節慶活動，包含表演、派對與工作坊，其中百分之六十五的節目為免費。走進這棟建築的訪客會注意到寧靜的氛圍，其特色為通風的色彩搭配以及採用六十萬個壓碎生蠔殼製成之紋理塗料的內牆。

paragraphs.en: The museum's opening exhibitions offer diverse experiences, ranging from space travel to a celebration of shopping malls. Task Eternal is the flagship opening exhibition, which requires a paid ticket for adults, and explores the history of air and space travel through various objects. Another exhibition called The Dark is designed for children aged four to twelve inside a large replica meteorite, requiring visitors to store their smartphones before entering. Additionally, an installation titled Overflow presents high-definition short films by director Ivan Sen on a 16-metre display, accompanied by a shallow pool of water.
paragraphs.zh: 該博物館的開幕展覽提供了多元的體驗，從太空旅行到對購物中心的慶祝活動。「永恆任務」（Task Eternal）是旗艦開幕展覽，成人需要購票入場，透過各種物件探索航空與太空旅行的歷史。另一個名為「黑暗」（The Dark）的展覽專為四至十二歲兒童設計，位於大型複製隕石內部，訪客在進入前必須存放他們的智慧型手機。此外，「滿溢」（Overflow）這個裝置藝術在十六公尺長的螢幕上呈現導演伊凡·山（Ivan Sen）的高畫質短片，並伴隨著一個淺水池。

grammar.explain: 使用關代子句來修飾先行詞 the museum，補充說明其忽略了舊館址的行為。
grammar.example: A group of critics, led by former staff and trustees, has complained that the museum neglected its Ultimo site to fund this new infrastructure project.
grammar.focus: that the museum neglected its Ultimo site to fund this new infrastructure project

grammar.explain: 使用被動語態表達執行長在開幕前遭到撤職的情況。
grammar.example: This led to a New South Wales Treasury investigation regarding the museum's governance and procurement practices, and CEO Lisa Havilah was stood down ten weeks before the opening.

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用不定詞片語來表達迎賓的動機與目的。
grammar.example: To welcome the public, the museum is offering a 23-day festival with performances, parties, and workshops, where 65% of the program will be free.

lessons.title: Elon Musk will face scrutiny from Democrats after midterms
lessons.title_zh: 馬斯克在期中選舉後將面臨民主黨人的嚴格審查

paragraphs.en: Tech billionaire Elon Musk could soon face intense investigations from lawmakers after Democratic candidates achieved sweeping victories in the midterm elections. Although Musk was not running for office, his businesses and political spending have placed him directly in the political spotlight. Records show that he provided over $445 million to support Republican candidates, political action committees, and outside groups. A large portion of this money, exceeding $200 million, was spent in Texas, where several of his major companies maintain their headquarters.
paragraphs.zh: 科技億萬富翁伊隆·馬斯克（Elon Musk）在民主黨候選人在期中選舉中取得全面勝利後，可能很快會面臨議員們的強烈調查。儘管馬斯克沒有參選，但他的企業和政治獻金使他直接成為政治焦點。記錄顯示，他提供超過4.45億美元來支持共和黨候選人、政治行動委員會和外部團體。其中很大一部分資金超過2.00億美元，花在了德州，他的幾家主要公司都在該州設有總部。

paragraphs.en: With Congress now under a Democratic majority, lawmakers plan to examine the billions of dollars in government contracts awarded to Musk's companies, including Tesla and SpaceX. They also intend to question his time leading the Department of Government Efficiency, known as DOGE, during the early stage of President Donald Trump's second term. The central issue for investigators is whether Musk utilized his political influence to help his own businesses while potentially putting public funds and state resources at risk.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著國會目前處於民主黨多數的掌控下，議員們計劃審查授予馬斯克旗下公司（包括特斯拉與太空探索技術公司SpaceX）的數十億美元政府合約。他們也打算對他在唐納·川普（Donald Trump）總統第二任期初期領導名為「政府效率部」（DOGE）的期間提出質疑。調查人員的核心問題是，馬斯克是否利用其政治影響力來幫助自己的事業，同時可能將公眾資金與國家資源置於風險之中。

paragraphs.en: Critics point out that while directing DOGE, Musk gained billions in government agreements, which could violate rules preventing officials from taking part in official matters that affect their personal finances. Furthermore, lawmakers are questioning his foreign connections and his decision to restrict Ukraine's access to Starlink internet services. Some politicians have argued that his ability to disrupt military operations for an ally without facing accountability is deeply concerning.
paragraphs.zh: 批評人士指出，馬斯克在領導DOGE期間獲得了數十億美元的政府協議，這可能違反了禁止官員參與影響其個人財務之官方事務的規定。此外，議員們正在質疑他的對外聯繫以及他限制烏克蘭使用星鏈（Starlink）網際網路服務的決定。一些政治人物認為，他在未面臨問責的情況下干擾盟友軍事行動的能力令人深感擔憂。

paragraphs.en: In Texas, Musk directed significant funds toward helping local Republican figures, such as Ken Paxton and Greg Abbott. However, these candidates were defeated as local voters favored Democratic opponents. During the campaign, political rivals accused the billionaire of attempting to buy political power in the state. Following the election results, Musk offered a brief comment on social media as political opponents celebrated their victories.
paragraphs.zh: 在德州，馬斯克將大筆資金投向協助肯·帕克斯頓（Ken Paxton）和葛雷格·艾波特（Greg Abbott）等當地共和黨政要。然而，這些候選人因當地選民青睞民主黨對手而落敗。在競選期間，政治對手指責這位億萬富翁試圖在該州買取政治權力。選舉結果出爐後，當政治對手慶祝他們的勝利時，馬斯克在社群媒體上發表了簡短的評論。

grammar.point: 關代受格省略 (Omission of Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 說明受格關係代名詞（此處為that）在子句中作為受詞時可以省略。
grammar.example: Records show that he provided over $445 million to support Republican candidates, political action committees, and outside groups.

grammar.point: 現在分詞當形容詞 (Present Participle as Adjective)
grammar.explain: 說明用V-ing形式修飾名詞，表示主動的意涵。
grammar.example: With Congress now under a Democratic majority, lawmakers plan to examine the billions of dollars in government contracts awarded to Musk's companies, including Tesla and SpaceX.

grammar.point: 不定詞表示目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 說明使用to加原形動詞來表達做某事的目的。
grammar.example: During the campaign, political rivals accused the billionaire of attempting to buy political power in the state.
